• Presiding at all executive sessions of independent trustees and any Board meetings in the unlikely event the Chairman is not present
• Serving as liaison between the Chairman and the other trustees
• Determining with the Chairman and CEO the necessary information trustees should receive regarding matters to be discussed at Board meetings
• Reviews and approves all related party transactions
• Reviews the Company's general compensation philosophy
• Evaluates the performance of the CEO in light of the above criteria and, together with the other independent trustees, approves the CEO's compensation level based on such evaluation
• Reviews and approves the CEO's evaluation of the performance of executives reporting to him before approving their compensation
